question.en: Navigate to http://[Target IP]:5601, click on the side navigation toggle, and click on "Dashboard". Review the "Failed logon attempts [All users]" visualization of the "SOC-Alerts" dashboard. Choose one of the following as your answer: "Nothing suspicious", "Consult with IT Operations", "Escalate to a Tier 2/3 analyst"
